brand.name: Vorntek
brand.description: An industry-neutral fictional example website with real content, inquiry and CRM workflows.
brand.intro: Advice, projects and ongoing support. Start with your question; keep the conversation and next step connected.
brand.introZh: 咨询、项目与持续支持。从你的问题开始，让沟通和下一步始终相连。

productLines.name: Individual advice
productLines.headline: Make room for the right question.
productLines.headlineZh: 从真正关心的问题开始。
productLines.description: A fictional one-to-one advice scenario. Company and project parameters are not required by this content category.
productLines.descriptionZh: 虚构的一对一咨询场景，内容分类本身不强制企业资料或项目参数。

productLines.name: Project planning
productLines.headline: Turn an idea into a shared plan.
productLines.headlineZh: 把想法，变成共同的计划。
productLines.description: A fictional team project with a brief, constraints and an agreed sequence of work.
productLines.descriptionZh: 虚构团队项目，包含需求说明、约束与共同确认的工作顺序。

productLines.name: Partner collaboration
productLines.headline: Explore a shared possibility.
productLines.description: A fictional partnership conversation, with clear participants and no invented commercial claims.
productLines.descriptionZh: 虚构合作沟通，明确参与者，不编造商业成果。

productLines.name: Learning session
productLines.headline: Build understanding together.
productLines.description: A fictional learning request with a topic, a preferred format and a recorded next step.
productLines.descriptionZh: 虚构学习请求，包含主题、期望形式与已记录的下一步。

productLines.name: Ongoing support
productLines.headline: Keep context with the conversation.
productLines.headlineZh: 让每次沟通都有上下文。
productLines.description: A fictional follow-up request linked to a previous discussion or reference, without forcing a new company record.
productLines.descriptionZh: 虚构跟进请求，可关联已有讨论或参考编号，不强制新建企业。

productLines.name: Content review
productLines.headline: Review before sharing.
productLines.description: A fictional content request showing how notes, revisions and approval boundaries can be discussed.
productLines.descriptionZh: 虚构内容请求，展示说明、修订与确认边界如何沟通。

productLines.name: Activity insight
productLines.headline: A useful view, with honest data.
productLines.description: Explore a deterministic synthetic request trend. The chart and downloadable CSV use the same example data, not actual business performance.
productLines.descriptionZh: 体验确定性合成请求趋势，图表与可下载CSV使用同一组示例数据，不代表实际业务表现。

contentDisclosure.en: Vorntek is a fictional example. All services, illustrations and scenarios are synthetic; they are not real clients, credentials, results or commercial offers. Use fictional information only. External delivery is disabled by default.
contentDisclosure.zh: Vorntek为虚构示例。服务、插图与场景均为合成内容，不代表真实客户、资质、成果或商业报价。仅填写虚构信息，对外发送默认关闭。
